title: 건너뛰기 오 초
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop R&B track featuring a smooth male vocal performance. The arrangement centers on a Rhodes electric piano playing jazz-influenced chords with a slight tremolo effect. A syncopated hip-hop beat drives the rhythm, consisting of a tight, dry kick drum, a crisp snare with a short reverb tail, and sixteenth-note closed hi-hat patterns. A melodic electric bass guitar follows the kick drum with a warm, rounded tone. Occasional record scratches and vinyl crackle textures are layered into the mix. The vocals utilize a mix of rhythmic rapping and melodic singing with subtle pitch correction and doubling. Key of E Major, 92 BPM, 4/4 time signature.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[Rhodes electric piano, record scratch, vinyl crackle]
Yeah, yeah
(Mmm)

[Verse 1]
[male vocals, syncopated hip-hop beat, electric bass enters]
이어폰 속 이불 속에 웅크려 앉아
자존감 회복이란 걸 검색해 봐
썸네일은 환해 제목은 달콤해
너는 충분해 넌 소중한 존재
재생 눌러서 3초도 안 됐는데
성형외과 광고야 왜 나한테
쌍꺼풀 코 톡스 세트 할인 중이래
자존감 찾으러 왔는데 가격표를
건너뛰기 5초가 5년 같아
화면 밝기에 눈이 따갑잖아
이어폰 속 힐링 노래가 울려
광고 사이에 묻혀서 안 들려
위로받으러 왔는데 상처만 늘어

[Chorus]
[melodic singing, Rhodes chords sustain]
자존감을 검색해
